# db-studio

> The modern pgAdmin alternative that works with every database

## Overview

db-studio is a modern database management tool designed to work with multiple database systems. It provides a clean, intuitive interface for managing databases, running queries, and exploring data.

## Key Features

- Multi-database support: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, CockroachDB, TiDB, SQL Server, MongoDB, SQLite, libSQL/Turso, Redis, DuckDB, Oracle, and ClickHouse
- Modern, intuitive user interface
- Cross-platform desktop application
- Query editor with syntax highlighting
- Table data browsing and editing
- Database schema visualization

## About

db-studio is built as a modern alternative to traditional database management tools like pgAdmin, offering a streamlined experience that works consistently across different database systems.

## Supported Databases

One page covers every database: https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases. Each section gives the connection URL and the limits.

- PostgreSQL (`postgresql://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#postgresql
- MySQL (`mysql://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#mysql
- MariaDB (`mariadb://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#mariadb
- CockroachDB (`cockroachdb://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#cockroachdb
- TiDB (`tidb://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#tidb
- SQL Server (`mssql://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#sql-server
- MongoDB (`mongodb://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#mongodb
- SQLite (`sqlite://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#sqlite
- Turso and libSQL (`libsql://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#turso
- Redis (`redis://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#redis
- DuckDB (`duckdb://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#duckdb
- Oracle (`oracle://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#oracle
- ClickHouse (`clickhouse://`): https://dbstudio.sh/docs/databases#clickhouse
